**Overview:**  
Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company that wholesales frozen food to restaurants in Sabah. It was incorporated on 20 Nov 2017, so it has been operating for a few years. The firm has three directors, with one director owning 98.86% of the share capital.
